fields.description: Issue includes radio program schedules (WCAU, WIOD, WQAM) and extensive horse-racing tips and promotions for a paid "Jockey Jimmy" information service. Local columns and notices reference American Legion visitors in Miami, Miami Beach nightlife and businesses, and a "They Tell Me That" gossip section. A feature lists "old-timers" and what they are doing now, and a political item discusses Glenn May potentially running for Florida governor (1936 platform). Includes a letter to the editor complaining about a rent increase in Miami and urging exposure of landlords who raise rents.
